title: Declared source fingerprint deliberately disagrees with the live target file
synthetic_rationale: Exercises the runner's fail-closed path: a mutant record whose declared source_fingerprint does not match the live target file (simulating drift since authoring time). The runner must refuse to test the unmodified candidate and report invalid-transform, never silently proceed. Not a per-head query mutation.
notes: source_fingerprint above is deliberately wrong (68 zero characters, also the wrong length) — this record's entire purpose is to prove the mismatch is caught before git apply or any detector ever runs.
